data.body: AC amendment: Name the new step 'Phase 1 Gate Step 1.5 — UI Intent Detection' (not 'Phase 1 Step 2.5') to avoid collision with existing Phase 2 Step 2.5 (cross-epic interaction scan). Insert it after 'Wait for confirmation before proceeding to Step 2.' and before 'Step 2 — Intent Gap Analysis'. The .test-index RED markers and test assertions using 'Phase 1.*Step 2.5|Step 2.5' should be updated to match the chosen name 'Step 1.5|UI Intent Detection'.
